_about: Legal level of every catalogue item. required = the PPWR text requires this content (in the TD, DoC or on the packaging) when the article applies; supporting = recommended evidence, one accepted way to demonstrate a legal requirement (the document type is not prescribed); practice = good practice beyond the legal text. 'why' cites the provision. Timing comes from the applicability matrix unless 'applies_from' overrides it.

name: Drawing
图纸
content: Title block: drawing number, revision, date, approver
图框：图号、版本、日期、批准人
以 mm 标注尺寸及公差
Material and grammage / thickness per component
每个组件的材料及克重 / 厚度
acceptance: Released revision (not a draft), legible, complete
已发布版本（非草稿）、清晰、完整
Revision matches the BOM and artwork
版本与 BOM 和 Artwork 一致
mistakes: Marketing render instead of a dimensioned drawing
用营销效果图代替带尺寸的图纸
No revision or date
无版本号或日期

name: Test report
检测报告
content: Laboratory, report number, date, sample identity
实验室、报告编号、日期、样品标识
acceptance: Covers the packaging as placed on the market and every relevant component
覆盖投放市场的包装及每个相关组件
Recent — this service uses ≤ 24 months (good practice)
时效——本服务采用 ≤ 24 个月（良好实践）
Accredited lab (ISO/IEC 17025) preferred
优先采用认可实验室（ISO/IEC 17025）
mistakes: Report for a different material grade or supplier
报告对应的材料牌号或供应商不同
Only one component tested
只检测了一个组件

name: Declaration
声明
content: Issuer, date, signature of an authorised person
签发方、日期、授权人签名
所覆盖的产品 / 材料 / 追溯码
Legal reference and the statement made
acceptance: Identifies exactly what it covers
明确所覆盖的对象
Signed and dated; still valid
已签名并注明日期；仍有效
mistakes: Generic 'we comply with all EU laws' letter
笼统的“符合所有欧盟法规”信函
Unsigned or undated
未签名或未注明日期

name: Material specification / TDS
材料规格书 / TDS
content: 关键性能（克重、厚度、密度）
acceptance: Matches the BOM line and trace code
与 BOM 行和追溯码一致
mistakes: Brochure without grade or version
无牌号或版本的宣传册

name: Photo / artwork
照片 / Artwork
content: All faces of the packaging; scale reference
acceptance: Legible text; final approved artwork version
文字清晰；最终批准版 Artwork
mistakes: Low-resolution photo where markings cannot be read
分辨率过低，标识无法辨认

name: BOM / register
BOM / 登记表
content: One line per component: material, mass (g), dimensions, supplier
每个组件一行：材料、质量(g)、尺寸、供应商
acceptance: Component masses add up to the unit mass (± 10 %)
组件质量之和与单元质量一致（±10%）
mistakes: Inks, adhesives or labels omitted
遗漏油墨、胶黏剂或标签

name: Calculation
计算
content: 输入、公式、结果、日期、编制人
acceptance: Inputs traceable to BOM / drawings
输入可追溯至 BOM / 图纸
mistakes: Result without inputs
只有结果没有输入数据

name: Record
记录
content: Date, batch / lot, responsible person, result
acceptance: Covers the period / batches in scope
覆盖范围内的期间 / 批次
mistakes: Blank template instead of a filled record
提交空白模板而非填写好的记录

name: Certificate
证书
content: 证书编号、持有人、范围、有效期
acceptance: Valid on the date of the TD; scope covers the material
在技术文档日期有效；范围覆盖该材料
mistakes: Expired certificate
证书已过期

name: Assessment report
评估报告
content: 范围、方法、输入、评估、结论
acceptance: Conclusion follows from the evidence cited
结论由所引用证据推出
mistakes: Conclusion without method or evidence references
结论缺少方法或证据引用
